title: Inoculation Theory Visualizer
description: Side-by-side population simulation comparing misinformation spread in a population with no prebunking against a population where ~65% have been prebunked (psychologically inoculated). Demonstrates the protective effect of prebunking and contrasts it with the limited reach of corrections deployed after misinformation has spread.
creator: Introduction to Public Health Project
subject: public health
health communication
misinformation
inoculation theory
learning_objective: Analyze how psychological inoculation (prebunking) reduces the spread of misinformation across a population, and compare its effectiveness to debunking after misinformation has spread.
chapter_title: Public Health Communication and Health Literacy
